entries.claim: Bitcoin's consensus code caps issuance at 21 million BTC and halves the block subsidy every 210,000 blocks.
entries.source_title: Bitcoin Core source: consensus/amount.h (MAX_MONEY = 21,000,000 × COIN)

entries.claim: All four scheduled halvings occurred at their fixed block heights: 210,000 (2012-11-28), 420,000 (2016-07-09), 630,000 (2020-05-11) and 840,000 (2024-04-20), UTC.
entries.source_title: Block 840,000 (fourth halving), 2024-04-20 UTC

entries.claim: Any user running a full node independently verifies every block, including the supply limit, without trusting miners.
entries.source_title: Bitcoin Core features: Validation

entries.claim: The U.S. dollar has lost 87.9% of its purchasing power since August 1971 (CPI 40.7 to 336.298, Sep 2026).
entries.source_title: CPI for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), U.S. city average, all items, seasonally adjusted [CUSR0000SA0]
entries.revision_note: Source changed from the FRED copy to the publishing agency; figure recomputed from the primary series and unchanged.

entries.claim: U.S. M2 money stock grew about 81x between January 1959 and August 2026.
entries.source_title: H.6 Money Stock Measures: M2, seasonally adjusted
entries.source_publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
entries.revision_note: Source changed from the FRED copy to the publishing agency; figure recomputed from the primary series and unchanged.

entries.claim: The Federal Reserve explicitly aims for 2% inflation over the longer run.
entries.source_title: Why does the Federal Reserve aim for inflation of 2 percent over the longer run?
entries.source_publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

entries.claim: Sovereign reserve assets can be frozen: Treasury immobilized the Russian central bank's U.S.-held assets in February 2022.
entries.source_title: Treasury Prohibits Transactions with Central Bank of Russia (Feb 28, 2022)

entries.claim: Gold has been subject to confiscation: the 1933 U.S. order required delivery of privately held gold to the Federal Reserve.
entries.source_title: Executive Order 6102: Forbidding the Hoarding of Gold Coin, Gold Bullion and Gold Certificates (April 5, 1933)
entries.source_publisher: The American Presidency Project, UC Santa Barbara

entries.claim: Custodial bitcoin carries platform risk: the SEC charged FTX's founder with defrauding investors and diverting customer funds (Dec 2022).
entries.source_title: SEC Charges Samuel Bankman-Fried with Defrauding Investors in Crypto Asset Trading Platform FTX (Dec 13, 2022)

entries.claim: Supply guarantees depend on software correctness: a 2010 bug created about 184 billion BTC before it was fixed.
entries.source_title: Value overflow incident (block 74638, August 15, 2010)

entries.claim: Regulatory tail risk: China declared all crypto transactions illegal in September 2021.
entries.source_title: Circular on further preventing and disposing of speculative risks in virtual currency trading (Yinfa [2021] No. 237)

entries.claim: Energy dependence: EIA estimates U.S. crypto mining uses 0.6%–2.3% of U.S. electricity.
entries.source_title: Tracking electricity consumption from U.S. cryptocurrency mining operations (Feb 2024)

entries.claim: Short history: the genesis block is dated January 3, 2009, so there are under 18 years of data, against gold's millennia.
entries.source_title: Block 0 (genesis), timestamp 2009-01-03 18:15:05 UTC

entries.claim: Central banks bought more than 1,000 tonnes of gold in 2024, about double the prior decade's annual average; at market prices gold reached 20% of global official reserves, passing the euro (16%) as the second-largest reserve asset after the U.S. dollar.
entries.source_title: The international role of the euro, June 2025 (Box 1: central bank gold purchases)

entries.claim: In the World Gold Council's 2025 central bank survey, a record 95% of respondents expected official gold reserves to rise over the next 12 months, and 76% expected gold to be a higher share of reserves in five years.
entries.source_title: Central Bank Gold Reserves Survey 2025: Perspectives on gold reserves

entries.claim: Two senior ECB officials argued that Bitcoin transactions are cumbersome, slow and expensive, that it has never been used to any significant extent for legal real-world transactions, and that with no cash flow or productive use its valuation rests purely on speculation (an opinion piece).
entries.source_title: Bitcoin's last stand (Bindseil & Schaaf, Nov 30, 2022)

entries.claim: After U.S. spot-ETF approval, the same ECB authors wrote that 'the fair value of Bitcoin is still zero' and argued that ETF wrapping does not change its fundamentals (an opinion piece using a cash-flow valuation framework).
entries.source_title: ETF approval for bitcoin: the naked emperor's new clothes (Bindseil & Schaaf, Feb 22, 2024)

entries.claim: El Salvador, the first country to make Bitcoin legal tender, amended its Bitcoin Law under a US$1.4 billion IMF program: private-sector acceptance became voluntary, taxes are payable only in U.S. dollars, and government Bitcoin transactions and purchases are confined.
entries.source_title: Press Release No. 25/043: IMF approves 40-month US$1.4 billion EFF for El Salvador (Feb 26, 2025)

entries.claim: WGC estimates the above-ground gold stock at about 222,600 tonnes (end-Q2 2026); about two-thirds was mined since 1950 and almost all of it still exists.
entries.source_title: How much gold has been mined? (about 222,600 tonnes in total)

entries.claim: WGC: average annual growth in gold mine production over the past ten years is less than 1%, and raising output quickly will be challenging.
entries.source_title: Gold Demand Trends full year 2025: Supply

entries.claim: Gold has a real production cost: the industry's all-in sustaining cost averaged US$1,605/oz in Q3 2025 (+9% y/y), per WGC.
entries.source_title: Gold Demand Trends full year 2025: Supply

entries.claim: Gold's effective supply responds to price: 2025 supply was a record 5,002.3t, including 1,404.3t of recycling on top of 3,671.6t of mine output (WGC).
entries.source_title: Gold Demand Trends full year 2025: Supply

entries.claim: Gold supply is not fixed: WGC puts below-ground reserves at about 61,000t and resources at about 114,400t.
entries.source_title: How much gold has been mined? (about 222,600 tonnes in total)

entries.claim: Official gold flows are only partly verifiable: WGC estimates 57% of 2025 central-bank buying was unreported.
entries.source_title: Gold Demand Trends full year 2025: Central banks

entries.claim: Bitcoin's current issuance (3.125 BTC per block, about 0.82% a year at the 10-minute target) is below gold's above-ground stock growth of about 1.8% a year (WGC 10-year average).
entries.source_title: Gold market primer: market size and structure (stock grows ~1.8% a year)

entries.claim: Host Hotels' FY2025 capex was $644M ($362M renewals and replacements plus $282M return-on-investment), 10.5% of $6,114M total revenue and 36.7% of $1,757M Adjusted EBITDAre (arithmetic on 10-K figures).

entries.claim: Nightly repricing: Host Hotels' comparable RevPAR rose 3.8% in 2025, from $220.84 to $229.24 (nominal, one REIT).

entries.claim: Bitcoin's design states that once a predetermined number of coins is in circulation, the incentive can move entirely to fees and be completely inflation free (design intent).
entries.source_title: Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System (2008)

entries.claim: Exchange risk: Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, pleaded guilty to BSA, unlicensed money-transmitting and sanctions violations, with penalties of $4,316,126,163; its CEO pleaded guilty and resigned (Nov 2023).
entries.source_title: Binance and CEO Plead Guilty to Federal Charges in $4B Resolution (Nov 21, 2023)

entries.claim: EU access through intermediaries now depends on MiCA authorisation (fully applicable since Dec 30, 2024; grandfathering to Jul 1, 2026), and ESMA lists non-compliant entities. Cuts both ways: it also gives legal clarity.
entries.source_title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)
